top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain is complete and mature: gut-derived GLP-1 potentiates glucose-dependent insulin secretion, the active truncated peptide was identified, and randomized trials show large glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov with a citation limited to the physiology and the identification of the active form avoids claiming first discovery of GLP-1 and sidesteps the unresolved Mojsov-Habener priority question. Awarding this is clearly preferable to no award.
